items.source: Placeholder class to be used in @Enable annotation's repositoryBaseClass attribute. The configuration evaluation infrastructure can use this type to find out no special repository base class was configured and apply defaults.
items.translation: 这是一个用于 `@Enable` 注解的 `repositoryBaseClass` 属性的占位符类。配置评估基础设施可以使用该类型来判断未配置特殊的仓库基类，并应用默认值。
